Name: NightLight
Author: kankur0
Description:
[size=3]NightLight allows you to adjust the darkness of night in various areas such as the outdoors, mines, farm cave, farmhouse, etc[/size]

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]﻿4.0.0 or higher[/size]
[/*]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url]﻿ [b](optional)[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file into your [i]Stardew/Mods[/i] folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configuration[/size]
[/b][size=3]You have two options for configuring NightLight.[/size]

[size=4][b]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Run the game and access GMCM from the bottom left icon on the title screen or within the mod options while in-game.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Check the features you wish to use.[/size]
[color=#ea9999][size=2][b]Note: "Enable NightLight" is required for all other features to work![/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=3]Adjust the darkness level to your preference.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Set the hotkeys you wish to use for toggling features on/off by clicking on the default hotkeys.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Config.json[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Open Config.json located Stardew/Mods/NightLight[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Set the value to true for the features you want enabled or false for the features you want disabled[/size][/*]
[*]Set the darkness level to your preference (0-100)[/*]
[*]Set the hotkeys as you please using the correct button codes found in the below links.
[url=https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/xna/bb197781(v%3dxnagamestudio.40)]Keyboard [/url]﻿| [url=https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/xna/bb975202(v%3dxnagamestudio.40)]Controller[/url][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Credits:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15683]Light Switch[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/161378458]HolyTheSea[/url][/*]
[/list]

[url=https://github.com/Kankur0/NightLight]Github Repo[/url]
